name: Saccharin
siboNotes: Saccharin is not fermentable by gut bacteria and does not contribute to SIBO symptoms. Safe for all phases of SIBO treatment.
preparationTips: Start with small amounts as some people may experience a metallic aftertaste
Works well in cold beverages and baking
Heat-stable, so suitable for cooking and baking applications
Mix with other sweeteners to improve taste profile if desired
pairsWellWith: Baked goods made with gluten-free flour
nutritionalHighlights: Does not contribute to tooth decay
